verdict.line: You lose if Aatrox lands Infernal Chains into a Deathbringer Stance auto before level 6; you win if you survive to Dusk and Dawn and force extended fights where A Thousand Cuts out-heals him.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's threat is front-loaded: Infernal Chains (W, 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown, range 825) and a periodically empowered Deathbringer Stance auto punish you before Gwen has Hallowed Mist or a fast Skip 'n Slash. Gwen's kit is the opposite, her passive stacking and untargetability in the mist only get strong once her cooldowns shrink and items land. The measured 48.4% win rate over 618 games matches that shape, this is a lane you survive, not one you win in trades.

theirWindow.when: levels 2-6 when Chains and Stance ready
theirWindow.what: Don't hold trades here. Stay out of Infernal Chains' 825 range until he commits it on a minion or whiffs, and never take a stance-empowered auto for free, back off or force him to walk it down.

yourWindow.when: his E and Q both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Dash in with E (Skip 'n Slash) for the attack speed, range, and magic on-hit window, land Q's true-damage center hits to stack passive, then disengage before Umbral Dash (5-9s cooldown) comes back.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The 92.9%-pick start (49.3% WR over 678 games). The extra sustain from two potions matters here specifically because you're absorbing Chains and stance-auto poke you can't always dodge before level 3.

boots.why: 48.4% WR over 287 games. Aatrox's damage is physical and auto-attack centric via Deathbringer Stance, the flat basic-attack reduction directly blunts his main poke and all-in tool.

core.why: First item in the highest win-rate path (59.7% over 62 games). Gets your passive-stacking damage online before his level 6 spike fully closes out.
Second in that same path, adds burst on top of A Thousand Cuts stacks for the trades you win after he's spent Chains or Umbral Dash.
Completes the 59.7% WR core, this is where Gwen's late-game duel power actually flips the matchup in your favor.

situational.when: the game is dragging into extended skirmishes where his passive and E healing keep outsustaining your trades
his Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash healing are keeping him alive through fights you should be winning
you're already ahead and want to close games out faster instead of tanking his autos (54.6% WR over 216 games)
you want more attack speed to stack A Thousand Cuts faster in prolonged duels

runes.keystoneWhy: This is a lane you survive into rather than win early, Conqueror's adaptive healing and stacking damage reward the extended trades and skirmishes Gwen wants once her mist and E cooldowns come online, not the short all-in trades Aatrox is built for.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the standard pick (68.9% pick rate, 49.4% WR), Ignite matters here since you need pressure to punish his cooldown windows and deny the healing from his passive and E. Teleport+Ignite (9.6% pick, 43.5% WR) is a fine alternative if you expect to be pushed off tower repeatedly pre-6.

playing.title: Bait Chains before committing
playing.detail: Infernal Chains has an 825 range and only damages you if you stay in the impact zone or get dragged to center. Walk near minions to bait it onto a wave, then punish the 12-20s cooldown.

playing.title: Hold Hallowed Mist for post-engage
playing.detail: Don't pre-cast W to farm, save it for the moment he commits Chains or E dashes in, since enemies outside the mist can't target you at all.

playing.title: Freeze before level 6
playing.detail: Solo-kill data favors him, so keep the wave near your tower levels 1-5 to deny the space his World Ender all-in needs when it comes online.

playing.title: Track Deathbringer Stance visually
playing.detail: His weapon glows when the empowered auto is up. Never extend a trade into a lit stance, it heals him for a percentage of your max health on top of the bonus damage.

playing.title: Use E to punish his cooldowns, not to open
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash's attack speed and range window refunds cooldown on hit, save it for after his Umbral Dash (5-9s CD) or Q charges are spent so he can't just dash away or swing through it.

playing.title: Snowball true damage after level 11
playing.detail: Q's cooldown drops to 4.25s and then 3.5s at max rank. Once you have Dusk and Dawn, isolated trades stack A Thousand Cuts fast enough to out-heal his sustain.

playing.title: Play for scaling, not lane kills
playing.detail: At 48.4% WR with lane and solo-kill advantage to Aatrox, contest CS and mist-dodge his cooldowns rather than looking for early kills you're statistically unlikely to convert.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (618-game Gwen vs Aatrox sample); the mechanical reasoning, power-curve breakdown, and trade windows are my own tactical read layered on top of that data.
